title: Jupyter Notebooks
motto: Notebooks are where ideas start. Scripts are where products ship.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Notebooks are where ideas start. Scripts are where products ship.

steps.title: Explore vs ship
cards: Upstream lessons use Jupyter for exploration — plot a loss curve, tweak a hyperparameter, visualize attention. The platform shell replaces tab-switching with one continuous flow.
You'll read notebook-shaped narratives here, then build in the editor pane. Knowing cell structure helps when you export to .py for production.

steps.title: Notebook structure
steps.body: A notebook is an ordered list of cells: markdown (narrative), code (executable), raw. The kernel runs code cells top-to-bottom; state persists until restart.

steps.title: Implement count_code_cells
steps.body: Given a list of cell dicts with cell_type ('code' | 'markdown'), return how many are code cells — the same check you'd run before exporting a notebook to a script.
